description: No account shall be opened in an anonymous or fictitious/benami name
source: RBI KYC Master Direction, Chapter III, Section 10(a)

description: No account or transaction shall proceed without following the CDD procedure
source: RBI KYC Master Direction, Chapter III, Section 10(c)

description: Customer identification is mandatory for walk-in transactions equal to or exceeding INR 50,000
condition: transaction_amount >= 50000 and is_walkin == True and identity_verified == False
source: RBI KYC Master Direction, Chapter V, Section 13(e)

description: An Aadhaar number, PAN, or Form 60 must be obtained from an individual establishing an account-based relationship
condition: aadhaar_present == False and pan_present == False and form60_present == False
source: RBI KYC Master Direction, Chapter VI, Section 15(a)

description: Customers must be categorised as low, medium, or high risk based on assessed risk perception
source: RBI KYC Master Direction, Chapter IV, Section 12(a)

description: Enhanced due diligence for PEPs requires senior-level approval and identification of source of funds
condition: is_pep == True and (senior_approval == False or source_of_funds_verified == False)
source: RBI KYC Master Direction, Chapter VI Part VI(A), Section 41

description: Suspicious transactions must be reported to FIU-IND without undue delay, and any day of delay is a separate violation
source: RBI KYC Master Direction, Chapter VIII, Section 49

description: Customer identity must not match any name on RBI-circulated sanctions lists
source: RBI KYC Master Direction, Chapter III, Section 10(i)

description: No account shall exist in the name of individuals/entities on the ISIL-Al Qaida or 1988 Taliban UNSC sanctions lists
source: RBI KYC Master Direction, Chapter IX, Section 51

description: Records of customer identity and transactions must be preserved for at least five years
source: RBI KYC Master Direction, Chapter VII, Section 46(a)-(b)

description: Risk categorisation must be reviewed at least once every six months
source: RBI KYC Master Direction, Chapter VI Part V, Section 37(a)

description: Periodic KYC updation must occur at least every 2 years (high risk), 8 years (medium risk), or 10 years (low risk)
condition: (risk_category == 'high' and years_since_update > 2) or (risk_category == 'medium' and years_since_update > 8) or (risk_category == 'low' and years_since_update > 10)
source: RBI KYC Master Direction, Chapter VI Part V, Section 38

description: Correspondent banking relationships shall not be entered into with shell banks
source: RBI KYC Master Direction, Chapter X, Section 64(f)

description: Domestic wire transfers of INR 50,000 or above must include originator information (name, address, account number)
source: RBI KYC Master Direction, Chapter X, Section 65(b)

description: Financial institutions must be prohibited from keeping anonymous accounts or accounts in obviously fictitious names
source: FATF Recommendation 10 - Customer Due Diligence

description: CDD must include identifying and verifying the customer's identity using reliable, independent source documents, data, or information
source: FATF Recommendation 10(a)

description: The beneficial owner must be identified, with reasonable measures taken to verify their identity
source: FATF Recommendation 10(b)

description: Where a financial institution cannot complete required CDD measures, it must not open the account, commence business relations, or perform the transaction
condition: cdd_completed == False and (account_opened == True or transaction_performed == True)
source: FATF Recommendation 10, final CDD failure clause

description: For foreign PEPs, senior management approval is required before establishing or continuing the business relationship
source: FATF Recommendation 12(b)

description: Correspondent banking relationships require senior management approval before establishment
source: FATF Recommendation 13(c)

description: Financial institutions must be prohibited from entering into or continuing correspondent relationships with shell banks
source: FATF Recommendation 13, shell bank prohibition clause

description: A suspicious transaction or suspected proceeds of criminal activity must be promptly reported to the FIU
source: FATF Recommendation 20

description: Countries/institutions must freeze without delay funds or assets of persons/entities designated under UNSC terrorism-related sanctions
source: FATF Recommendation 6 - Targeted Financial Sanctions (Terrorism)
